deliverable.description: UTF-8 JavaScript defining a deterministic, pointwise predict(design) that returns a finite number; larger means higher predicted coercivity

design_space.description: one design = one composition of the Co-Fe-Ni spread, in at.%; every round orders from the same pool and each composition can be measured once

measurements.description: coercive field, in millitesla; higher is better
measurements.name: coercivity_mt

measurements.description: Kerr rotation, in milliradians, a magneto-optical measure of the film's magnetisation; reported, not an objective
measurements.name: kerr_rotation_mrad

objective: Search a Co-Fe-Ni thin-film composition spread for high magnetic coercivity over four rounds of 16 compositions, finding the best compositions of every one of its coercivity peaks, then build a model that ranks held-out compositions by coercivity.
